description: Inline feedback box on backlog items at in_progress/review/pr_pending/done that sends the item back to ready with the operator's feedback recorded and retriage started, in one submit
testIds: toggle button reveals a role=form with a required textarea, and Submit starts disabled
box renders nothing when visible is false
submit is enabled only once non-empty text is typed
Escape in the textarea cancels the form, clears text, and returns focus to the toggle
a resolved onSubmit clears the form
renders the InlineNotice only when activeWorkSessionCount > 0
a plain rejected onSubmit (no SendBackError) preserves typed text and shows the generic headline
SendBackError("transition", ...) shows the same generic "Failed to send back" headline
SendBackError("triage", "ready", ...) points at "Regenerate Plan with This Feedback"
SendBackError("reject", "ready", ...) points at "Request Changes"
SendBackError("triage", "idea", ...) names "idea", offers no "will fail" claim, and renders Retry
clicking Retry resubmits the same feedback, clears the error immediately, and a resolved retry behaves like a fresh success
clicking Retry with an emptied textarea is a no-op
Cancel is a no-op while isPending is true
Escape in the textarea is a no-op while isPending is true
the Cancel button is disabled/aria-disabled while isPending
stays mounted showing the error UI when visible becomes false after a partial failure, and dismiss unmounts it cleanly
renders null immediately when visible=false and there is no actionError
is never absent during a Retry's own pending window, even from visible=false
on a second rejection, shows the appropriate error again and remains mounted
BacklogItemDetail source contains no send_back_refining case or toast entry
submits feedback through transitionStatus, rejectPlan, and triggerTriage in order, shows a success toast, and reloads
does not call rejectPlan or triggerTriage when transitionStatus rejects
reloads before showing the error toast when triggerTriage fails after transitionStatus and rejectPlan succeed
reloads before showing the error toast when rejectPlan fails after transitionStatus succeeds
